# graphiant_regions (Data Source)

Graphiant regions, used by graphiant_gateway/graphiant_public_vif's region_id and graphiant_device_config's region. Coordinates are not yet exposed.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "graphiant_regions" "all" {}

output "available_region_ids" {
  value = [for r in data.graphiant_regions.all.regions : r.id if !r.unavailable]
}
```
